before_after_same_seeds.metric: GT path length in the first 20 s of sim time (before runs were capped there)

notes.how_measured: python -m metagross.sim.batch --split dev --workers 2 (tier0: all 30 DEV seeds 100-129 per config; stereo: --sensor-mode stereo --seeds 102 103 104 --max-sim-s 90), then python -m metagross.sim.closed_loop_summary. Referee verdicts on simulator ground truth; autonomy in a separate process behind the GT file guard. Every stereo run ended on a referee terminal event ('stuck', no 0.5 m progress in 20 s) before the 90 s cap.

configs.TYPICAL: unknown_is_free=True, use_negobs=False, use_governor=False, fixed_speed_mps=1.5 (same planner / controller / map code)

notes.code_state: Autonomy planning/safety/control/node code identical for all three final batches (no edits to those files between 05:10 and 05:53; the later INFER_DYNAMIC experiment was reverted to the value these runs used). TYPICAL started 04:58: changes landing during its window (void layer, void range, planner crop) are inert or numerically identical when unknown_is_free=True.
notes.shared_tree_caveat: Perception was being changed by another agent in the same working tree (perception/pipeline.py last modified 05:14, adding certified_local / r_det_m which this stack consumes). Each episode imports the code on disk when its autonomy process starts; the TYPICAL batch (04:58-05:16) therefore straddles that perception change.
notes.machine: shared 4-core / 8-thread laptop with 5 other agents' jobs (incl. a segmentation training run) active; compute ms are wall time per 5 Hz tick under that load
notes.arrived_est: fraction of runs whose supervisor declared ARRIVED in the vehicle's own pose estimate. Tier0 frames carry no images, so localisation is wheel + gyro only; the scenarios' longitudinal slip (3-8 %) makes wheel odometry over-estimate distance and the vehicle stops 2.2-4.4 m short of the true goal (success radius 2 m). This column separates planning competence from that drift.
notes.false_stops: referee count; includes the estimated-arrival stop when the true goal is outside the success radius

dynamic_inference.on_final: tier0 FULL: 3/30 success, arrived_est 0.53, 1 collision (F4 moving box 105); stereo 102/103/104: 2.0 / 1.9 / 1.8 m then stuck
dynamic_inference.off_archived: tier0 FULL (results/runs_dev_tier0/_v3_nodyn_FULL, 05:39-05:52): 3/30 success, arrived_est 0.63, drive speed 1.31 m/s, 3 collisions (F4 105 box, F4 123 boulder, F1 102 static rock graze 1 mm at 0.77 m/s); stereo (results/runs_dev_stereo/_v2_nodyn_FULL): 8.4 / 1.8 / 2.2 m then stuck
dynamic_inference.decision: kept ON (rolling_map.INFER_DYNAMIC) because collisions weigh more; stereo 102/103 contain no moving objects yet had 50-74 DYNAMIC map cells within +-4 m (flickering static perception false positives)
